adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6` the `addMembers` action calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));` but never clears `usernames` afterward; the code even notes `// TODO: should clear the input`. This can lead to repeated submissions of the same usernames on subsequent clicks and provides no UI reset/feedback in the controller/template logic shown, but it’s primarily a UX/completeness issue rather than a strictly verifiable correctness failure from the diff alone.
